question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: Bury the hatchet
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Make peace after disagreement. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Bury the hatchet"** means to make peace or resolve a disagreement with someone. It is used when two people or groups decide to stop arguing or fighting and reconcile. (लड़ाई खत्म करके मेल-मिलाप करना) • **Example:** After years of rivalry, the two friends decided to bury the hatchet and start afresh. Hence, the correct meaning of "Bury the hatchet" is to **make peace after disagreement**. (लड़ाई खत्म करके शांति स्थापित करना) • **Example:** The neighbors finally buried the hatchet after a long-standing dispute over their property boundaries. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Make hostility worse** (शत्रुता को और बढ़ाना): This refers to intensifying a conflict or making a situation worse. It is the opposite of the correct answer. • **Example:** His rude comments only served to make the hostility worse between the two teams. • **Option 3: Leave the place hurriedly** (जल्दी से जगह छोड़ देना): This refers to leaving a place quickly, often in a rush or panic. • **Example:** When the fire alarm went off, everyone left the building hurriedly. • **Option 4: Fail to recall someone’s name** (किसी का नाम याद करने में असफल होना): This refers to forgetting someone’s name, often in a social or professional setting. • **Example:** I’m so embarrassed that I failed to recall her name during the meeting. 37:T90d, The correct answer is: **Glutton**.
